description: About Debra Representative Debra Lekanoff's extensive career in public service spans more than three decades, during which she has faithfully served the 40th Legislative District, Washington State, Tribal communities, and served in federal roles under both Democratic and Republican administrations. Her dedication to enacting policies, regulations, and fiscal investments that positively impact communities is commendable.
